approved_decisions.3F-1: Limit current provider scope to Apify profile search and its separately governed email-search action.
approved_decisions.3F-2: Keep Apollo, Clay and other providers unselected pending Equinet tests.
approved_decisions.3F-3: Keep all monetary caps and approvers pending and block runtime while any required value is missing.
approved_decisions.3F-4: Use a ten-candidate benchmark with the existing per-candidate source limits.
approved_decisions.3F-5: Reuse successful idempotent results, do not retry not-found or blocked outcomes and allow one transient technical retry.
approved_decisions.3F-6: Prohibit automatic fallback to another provider.
approved_decisions.3F-7: Hold personal emails for human privacy review and prohibit operational use before approval.
approved_decisions.3F-8: Attribute provider email to the independent HarvestAPI search, not LinkedIn.
approved_decisions.3F-9: Require daily visibility, monthly statements and a hard stop before any approved cap or prepaid balance is exceeded.
approved_decisions.3F-10: Keep runtime blocked until account, rights, vendor, retention, budget, audit and connector gates pass.

remaining_activation_inputs: Apify workspace/account, runtime owner and credential route
test, daily and pilot USD caps
personal-email review owner and final outcomes
